title: Retro Screens
summary: Three original classic-genre screens under console-era limits: an 8-bit rooftop platformer, a Game Boy-style village RPG and an 8-bit title screen.
request: Unknown: the original request was not recorded in the repository. SOURCES notes describe the three screens as original: characters, places, titles and text; console names describe hardware limits only. Source description: original classic-genre screens under console-era limits: an 8-bit platformer, a Game Boy-style RPG, an 8-bit title screen.
